text: I've had this cough going on for about two months now. It usually brings up some clear sputum, but I haven't coughed up any blood. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see the stroke history is noted, but I need to focus on the respiratory symptoms. Have you noticed any fever, night sweats, or unintended weight loss alongside this cough?

text: No, I haven't had any fever or night sweats, and I haven't lost any weight. The cough is actually worse at night, and I do get short of breath when I try to do physical work.
